title: Confession and Ledger
author: Tamsin Brightwater
blurb: Sebastian Pemberton, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
